notes.raw:
Phase changes: 582 K, $\alpha-\beta$ transition point of Ba; $\Delta H^{\circ}=0$ kcal/mol. 
768 K, β - γ transition point of Ba; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0$ kcal/mol. 
1002 K, melting point of Ba; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 1.852$ kcal/mol. 
Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 
298.15-2000 K: $Cp^{\circ} = 8.867 + 0.148 \times 10^{-3} T - 0.372 \times 10^{5} T^{-2}$ 
$H^{0}-H_{298}^{0}=8.867\times10^{-3}T+0.074\times10^{-6}T^{2}+0.372\times10^{2}T^{-1}-2.775$ 
Reaction equations (kcal/mol): 
298.15-582 K: $\Delta \mathrm{Hr}^{\circ} = -10.659 + 14.418 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} - 18.336 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 496.550 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ 
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -10.659 - 14.418 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 18.336 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 248.275 \mathrm{T}^{-1} + 71.146 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
582-768 K: $\Delta \mathrm{Hr}^{\circ} = -7.139 + 2.178 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} - 5.196 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 3.050 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ 
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -7.139 - 2.178 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 5.196 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 1.525 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 4.453 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
768-1002 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -4.183 - 5.964 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} + 0.395 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 2.650 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ 
$\Delta \mathrm{Gr}^{\circ} = -4.183 + 5.964 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} - 0.395 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 1.325 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 58.101 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
1002-2000 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -11.437 - 1.897 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} - 0.735 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 2468.950 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ 
$\Delta \mathrm{Gr}^{\circ} = -11.437 + 1.897 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 0.735 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 1234.475 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 25.120 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
Source: Data from Chase (17) who estimated some molecular constants.
